items.title: Q-040c dACC PE-weight delta correlation, dacc_weight config fix (supersedes V3-EXQ-862)
items.note: Successor to V3-EXQ-862 in the goal_pipeline:GAP-4 Tier-1 cohort. 862 fixed 475b's z_harm_a=None defect (enable_affective_harm_stream=True) and confirmed it works (n_dacc_fires=451 seed 42, up from 0; P1 PASSed 2/3 seeds), but hit a SECOND, INDEPENDENT config-omission bug: dacc_bias_nonzero_steps=0 in every one of 6 seed-x-arm cells (confirmed via REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-862_2026-08-02.md). Root cause, code-verified at ree_core/cingulate/dacc.py:505-566 (DACCtoE3Adapter.forward): 'All multipliers default to 0, so with default config the bias is the zero vector regardless of bundle content' -- DACCConfig.dacc_weight defaults to 0.0 and 862's driver never set it (confirmed by grep, zero mentions). This is a stage entirely independent of and downstream from the z_harm_a wiring 862 fixed: dACC computing a PE each tick (n_dacc_fires>0) is necessary but not sufficient for a nonzero behavioural bias, since the bias consumer's own gain was structurally zero. 862's own preflight gate checked pe/bias definedness (not None), which a guaranteed-zero bias (bias_mag=0.0) still satisfies -- caught 475b's defect class, structurally blind to this one. FIX (only substantive change from 862): _build_arm_config now sets cfg.dacc_weight=0.5 and cfg.dacc_interaction_weight=0.5 directly on the REEConfig object returned by build_config (flat REEConfig attributes, not nested; build_config itself has no dacc_weight kwarg). 0.5 mirrors the established convention (v3_exq_637_sd057_phase2_cue_recall_consume.py and 445c/445f/445g/455/848 all use dacc_weight=0.5). NEW preflight gate: PreflightDaccBiasZero, raised if dACC fires but peak bias magnitude never exceeds the 1e-6 floor (extends the existing PreflightDaccNotFiring check per the autopsy's explicit routing: 'extending the preflight to assert bias MAGNITUDE nonzero, not just definedness'). Everything else -- P1 MECH-269b V_s-gating precondition, the Spearman-rho(|PE|, dACC bias-magnitude) correlation statistic, seeds 42/7/19, the 2-arm ARM_vs_off/ARM_vs_on structure, acceptance thresholds -- is unchanged from 862. Verified this session: preflight pilot (seed 42, ARM_vs_on) measured n_dacc_fires=20, peak_bias_magnitude=199.442 (previously structurally 0.0 under 862); a direct instrumented call to run_seed_arm (both arms, seed 42, dry-run scale) measured dacc_bias_nonzero_steps=25 of n_dacc_fires=25 (100%, was 0/25 under 862) in BOTH ARM_vs_on and ARM_vs_off, bias_magnitude_series ranging ~587-750 (non-degenerate spread), rho_pe_vs_bias_magnitude=0.277 (defined, not degenerate). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is the dACC bias-magnitude vs precision-weighted-PE correlation WITH dACC actually emitting a nonzero bias. reanalysis_query.py query --readout rho_pe_vs_bias_magnitude --claim Q-040 returns only 475b and 862's manifests, both with dacc_bias_nonzero_steps=0 in every cell (862) or n_dacc_fires=0 (475b) -- nothing to reanalyze. Not recoverable -> proceed to author. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): 0 prior substrate_ceiling autopsies tag claim_ids=["Q-040"] (grep-count method over REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_*.json) -- does not fire; both 475b's and 862's autopsies are correctly-excluded measurement/instrumentation categories, not substrate_ceiling. validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 findings. --dry-run: both cells complete, verdict PASS x2, correctly self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue at the 1-seed smoke scale (P1/P2 both require >=2/3 seeds) -- expected, matching 862's own smoke-scale behaviour, not a defect.

items.title: MECH-267 content-persistence retest with BOTH noise-scale + horizon-depth mechanisms active (supersedes V3-EXQ-869)
items.note: Same-question retest of V3-EXQ-869 (superseded by this entry). V3-EXQ-869 (30 seeds, pre-registered, USER-CONFIRMED failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-869_2026-08-02.json) found MECH-267 content-persistence PASSed the iters=1 manipulation check but FAILED at production num_cem_iterations=3 under noise-scale-only (mode_noise_scale). The autopsy's determination was competence_implementation_gap, not claim falsification: MECH-267's own registration names a second mechanism (horizon-depth) that was not yet built. That mechanism (SD-MECH267-HORIZON-DEPTH, ree-v3 e0117eea8b, 2026-08-02; design doc REE_assembly/docs/architecture/sd_mech267_horizon_depth_modulation.md) is now built, gated by the same mode_conditioning_enabled flag as mode_noise_scale, so this script's unchanged HippocampalModule construction now exercises BOTH mechanisms simultaneously. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is mean_raw_std_by_dim pairwise gaps at num_cem_iterations=3 with BOTH mode_noise_scale and mode_horizon_scale active -- no prior manifest carries this combined-mechanism condition (mode_horizon_scale did not exist before e0117eea8b, 2026-08-02), so it is not recoverable from existing evidence -> proceed to run. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): grep-count of confirmed substrate_ceiling/non_contributory autopsies tagging MECH-267 = 1 (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-869_2026-08-02.json only), below the threshold of 2 -> brake does not fire. Same DV, modes-in-predicted-order, and pairwise-gap floors (FLOOR_DIAGNOSTIC=0.015, FLOOR_PRODUCTION=0.01) as V3-EXQ-869 -- a same-question re-queue, not a redesign; new claim_ids tag unchanged (['MECH-267'] only -- SD-MECH267-HORIZON-DEPTH is a substrate_queue entry, not a claim). Smoke test (validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 findings; --dry-run: 3 seeds, verdict PASS x3) confirms via a new mechanism_activation diagnostic block that BOTH mechanisms fire together every cell (mode_noise_scale_used and mode_horizon_scale_used both non-None; effective_horizon varies by mode: external_task=2, internal_replay=3, internal_planning=offline_consolidation=4 out of HORIZON=4) -- not merely asserted from config inspection. A 10-seed toy-scale pilot (both conditions, run outside the committed script, not gating) found the iters=1 manipulation check clears FLOOR_DIAGNOSTIC cleanly and with the full predicted ordering in 10/10 seeds, but the iters=3 production gaps (mean 0.0050 / 0.0027 / -0.0025) remain near the FLOOR_PRODUCTION=0.01 threshold -- similar magnitude to V3-EXQ-869's original noise-scale-only result (-0.0003 / +0.0035 / -0.0037). This is reported honestly, not as a pre-judgment: it is not gating (the full 30-seed pre-registered run is what determines PASS/FAIL), and either outcome is informative -- a second FAIL would indicate the breadth-axis DV specifically does not benefit from adding horizon-depth truncation to elite selection (pointing toward the score-aggregation mechanism itself, not a missing-mechanism gap), while a PASS would confirm the implementation-gap hypothesis the autopsy proposed.

items.title: MECH-166 wall-independent representation confirmer (sleep-cycle write-counter recording fix)
items.note: Supersedes V3-EXQ-436b (FAIL on C1, recommended_evidence_direction non_contributory per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-436b_2026-08-02.json/.md, confirmed 2026-08-02, user-approved as recommended). FIX 1 (the requested fix): 436b discarded agent.run_sleep_cycle()'s entire return value with `_ = ...`, so sws_n_writes/rem_n_rollouts were never captured. 436c captures them and adds a P0 positive-control gate (p0_readiness_gate/P0NotReady, mirroring V3-EXQ-671b's MECH-025b residue-accumulation gate) requiring both counters, pooled across all 5 SWS_THEN_REM seeds, to clear >0 before C1 (slot_cosine_sim) is scored -- unmet routes to FAIL/non_contributory/sleep_cycle_recording_gap_still_present rather than a silent, uninterpretable readout. FIX 2 (found during this session's own smoke testing, not in the original autopsy): agent._e1_tick() -- the ONLY call site in ree_core/agent.py that appends to agent._world_experience_buffer/_self_experience_buffer (SWS write-path source) and pushes into agent.theta_buffer (REM read source) -- is invoked exclusively from agent.act()-style entry points; this driver's manual harm-based action-selection loop (unchanged from 436b) calls agent.sense() directly and never agent.act(), so both stores were PERMANENTLY EMPTY regardless of the Fix-1 capture, and run_sws_schema_pass()'s n_buf<2 / run_rem_attribution_pass()'s recent-is-None guards fired on every sleep pass unconditionally -- confirmed via a standalone 200-step repro before touching the driver. This also fully explains failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-436b_2026-08-02's 'core anomaly' (slot_cosine_sim bit-identical between conditions to full float64 precision, every seed): ContextMemory.memory is an nn.Parameter randomly initialised via torch.randn(...)*0.01, and arm_cell(seed,...) reseeds torch's global RNG to the SAME seed for both conditions before each agent is constructed, so both conditions' memory started bit-identical and -- since .write() never fired in either -- never diverged. Fixed by directly feeding _world_experience_buffer/_self_experience_buffer/theta_buffer in _run_episode, mirroring _e1_tick's own append+trim+theta_buffer.update exactly, WITHOUT its other side effects (extra E1 forward pass, cue-bias/schema-salience/self-recurrence caching) which this driver's design does not otherwise exercise. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): SD-017 1 braking autopsy (V3-EXQ-538a), ARC-045 0, MECH-166 0 -- all below the >=2 threshold, brake does not fire. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (slot_cosine_sim paired comparison, now with non-zero write counters) not recorded anywhere -- 436b's own manifest is the only prior run and is exactly the defect being fixed. Smoke test (--dry-run, 11 episodes to clear SLEEP_INTERVAL=10): SWS_THEN_REM sleep_passes=1, sws_n_writes_total=8.0, rem_n_rollouts_total=6.0 (both non-zero, matching sws_consolidation_steps=8/rem_attribution_steps=6 exactly); WAKING_ONLY correctly 0.0/0.0 (no sleep phase). slot_cosine_sim now differs between conditions in the smoke (0.2068 vs 0.2224) and slot_separation is no longer pinned at 0.0 for SWS_THEN_REM (1.013) -- both were previously bit-identical/0.0 under 436b's defect. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings.

items.title: MECH-025b precision-responsibility: precision-variance positive-control gate + 4-seed pooling (corrects 671a's asymmetric gate)
items.note: Confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-671a_2026-08-02 (user-confirmed 2026-08-02, routed measurement_gap/non_contributory, recommended /queue-experiment): 671a FAILed discrimination cleanly (C1 corr=0.0505, C2 ratio=0.9214, n=29, single seed) after genuinely fixing 671's degenerate defect (update_residue never called) and adding a residue-accumulation P0 gate that cleared (1.86 vs 1e-6 floor). Autopsy found an ASYMMETRIC GAP: no equivalent P0 gate on precision VARIANCE (the independent variable), despite this being the exact historical MECH-025 V2 failure signature ('E3 precision hardcoded, no dynamic channel'); plus underpowered single-seed n=29. FIX 1 (precision-variance P0 gate): added 'precision_shows_adequate_variance' (pooled max-min precision_samples spread > PRECISION_VARIANCE_FLOOR=1.0, mirroring the residue gate's floor-well-below-observed convention) PLUS a secondary check_degeneracy call in GROUPS mode over per-seed precision_samples (catches within-seed pinning masked by cross-seed mean differences -- the metric_groups_are_degenerate class, applied here to the correlation test's independent variable rather than a multi-arm comparison). Substrate check performed before writing (per autopsy instruction not to assume 'still hardcoded'): E3TrajectorySelector.current_precision = 1/(running_variance+1e-6) is genuinely dynamic (ARC-016, stable, V3-confirmed via V3-EXQ-018b); update_running_variance is called inside e3.select() on every e3_tick, so precision updates during eval too -- confirmed empirically via smoke (see below), not assumed. FIX 2 (underpowering): 4 seeds (0-3) instead of 671a's single seed=0, primary C1/C2 computed on samples pooled across all seeds (~4x n), per-seed correlation/ratio also reported as non-gating diagnostics for transparency. GOV-REUSE-1: this exact instrumentation (precision-variance gate) does not exist in any prior manifest for MECH-025b -- not recoverable, must run. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): only 1 prior autopsy tags MECH-025b as substrate_ceiling-adjacent-relevant (671a itself, category measurement_gap, not substrate_ceiling) plus batch9 (n/a degenerate) -- below the >=2 threshold, does not fire. Substrate readiness (Step 2.5): MECH-025/MECH-025b both `status: candidate`, no v3_pending/implementation_phase:v3 gate; claims.yaml's own evidence_quality_note says 'V3 gate cleared 2026-03-28'. Smoke (--dry-run, 2 seeds, warmup=5/eval=2/steps=50): both P0 gates fire correctly (mechanically verified: script runs, prints per-seed verdict lines + Seed/Condition boundaries, pooled stats aggregate); real precision-variance numbers even at this toy scale: seed 1 pooled_precision_spread=39.99 across 4 committed samples (seed 0 had only 1 committed sample, spread trivially 0) -- confirms precision genuinely varies within a single eval run, not near-constant, well above the 1.0 floor. A second, larger single-seed calibration run (warmup=100/eval=15/steps=200, seed=0, run to completion not just --dry-run) measured precision_spread=63300.34 across 8 committed samples (values ranging ~3 to ~63309 -- three orders of magnitude), corr=0.2103, ratio=1.2222, elapsed=381.8s -- confirms the gate floor (1.0) sits far below genuine substrate-level precision variance (not a knife-edge threshold), and gives the estimated_minutes scaling basis below (this calibration seed's step count is ~1/4.8th of one real full-scale seed). validate_experiments.py --strict: clean (0 findings). items.title: Q-004 tau_R calibration at larger training budget, selection-instrument fixed (supersedes V3-EXQ-149)
items.note: Q-004 replication at a larger training budget, per claims.yaml what_would_answer. Re-derive brake (2.5b): 0 failure_autopsy artifacts exist for Q-004/EXQ-149. items.title: INV-034/Q-021: goal-maintenance-vs-avoidance-only ablation, re-run on scaffolded_sd054_onboarding curriculum (supersedes V3-EXQ-866)
items.note: Supersedes V3-EXQ-866 (FAIL/non_contributory, confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-866_2026-08-02, user-approved 2026-08-02): 866's G0 gate failed on the lightweight direct-REEConfig harness -- FULL resource_visit_rate 0.0046 BELOW RANDOM 0.0217. Autopsy routing (IGW-222 DESIGN.md 5.8 Option B): re-run on scaffolded_sd054_onboarding.py (already-built, validated substrate; 603q/833 lineage). Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b) checked live 2026-08-02: INV-034 and Q-021 each count=1 autopsy (866 itself) against threshold=2 -- brake does not fire (866's own category is substrate_not_ready_requeue/action:none, not a genuine substrate_ceiling; counted only via the documented non_contributory-direction proxy, which is below threshold regardless). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout (866-style transition-type resource_visit_rate under a FULL-vs-AVOIDANCE_ONLY-vs-RANDOM ablation, measured on the scaffolded curriculum's own P2-phase target env) is not recorded in any existing manifest -- no prior scaffolded_sd054_onboarding consumer computes this exact statistic (they use contact_rate/approach_commit_rate instead); not recoverable, run. Design: same 3 conditions and identical G0-C6 gate formulas/margins as 866; FULL and AVOIDANCE_ONLY share ONE ScaffoldedSD054OnboardingConfig (Stage-0 forced-feed nursery, Stage-0b protected consolidation, P0 warmup, isolated Stage-H hazard-avoidance leg with harm-pathway training [603k/603q], P1 anneal, custom 866-style P2 measurement) -- only the REEConfig differs (z_goal/MECH-295/MECH-307/incentive-bank/cue-recall on for FULL, off for AVOIDANCE_ONLY; harm/avoidance channel identical in both, per 866's own C1/C2 invariant). RANDOM measured on the SAME P2-phase env for parity. PRE-QUEUE VERIFICATION (2026-08-02, this session): a reduced-budget single-seed check (~1/3 episodes, half steps) initially reproduced 866's exact failure mode -- resource_visit_rate near-zero for ALL THREE conditions (FULL 0.0045/AVOIDANCE_ONLY 0.0058/RANDOM 0.0058) -- root-caused to leaving scaffold_p2_hazard_food_attraction_guard at its class default (-1.0, no guard; P2 env stays at the harsh hazard_food_attraction=0.7, which the module's own docstring already warns can suppress contact for ANY policy). Grep of every landed scaffolded_sd054_onboarding consumer (603*/793*/812*.py) confirmed the guard is set to 0.3 near-universally in practice; script fixed to P2_HFA_GUARD=0.3 accordingly. Re-verified at the same reduced scale: RANDOM resource_visit_rate=0.0 (zero contact), FULL=0.0074, AVOIDANCE_ONLY=0.0086 -- both trained arms now clear RANDOM in relative terms, confirming the measurement window itself is no longer degenerate. G0's ABSOLUTE 0.05 margin is NOT yet cleared at this deliberately reduced (single-seed, ~1/6-scale-by-total-env-steps) verification budget -- that is expected and not itself a finding: the margin was pre-registered assuming the FULL 250-episode/200-step/3-seed budget, and this reduced check exists only to catch code-level and harness-configuration bugs (which it did -- the P2 guard) before committing to the full run, not to statistically resolve the hypothesis at 1/6 scale. Whether FULL clears the 0.05 margin at full budget is the open empirical question this queued run answers. estimated_minutes derived from measured wall-clock (988s for FULL+AVOIDANCE_ONLY+RANDOM at ~1/6 total-env-steps scale per cell) linearly scaled by the full/reduced env-step ratio (6.25x) x3 seeds.
